description: This file implements the OpenRouterEmbedder class, which provides embedding functionalities with batching, rate limiting, and error handling, using the OpenAI API compatible interface. It includes methods for creating embeddings, validating configuration, and managing global rate limits.

classes.name: OpenRouterEmbedder
classes.description: A class implementing the IEmbedder interface for OpenRouter, supporting batching, rate limiting, and error handling for embedding requests.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates embeddings for a list of texts with batching and rate limiting.

methods.name: _embedBatchWithRetries
methods.description: Handles batch embedding with retries and exponential backoff.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration by testing API connectivity.

methods.name: waitForGlobalRateLimit
methods.description: Waits if there's an active global rate limit.

methods.name: updateGlobalRateLimitState
methods.description: Updates global rate limit state upon receiving a 429 error.

methods.name: getGlobalRateLimitDelay
methods.description: Returns the current delay based on global rate limit state.
